approach: Hybrid refinement of existing Tripo reconstruction; no new generation credits spent
changes: Preserved reconstructed bracelet, lugs, crown and rear case; smoothed reconstruction noise with twelve alternating Taubin passes
Replaced irregular fused front surface with a circular bezel, thirty separate faceted diamonds, a clean dial and independent crystal
Diamond shader traces up to five internal reflections against actual convex facet planes, with approximate wavelength-dependent refraction
Crystal uses a thin-pane Fresnel reflection approximation with an illustrative sapphire index of 1.76; no baked glare or dial blur
Setting specimen uses smooth illustrative turned metal profiles and an independently shaded diamond
GLB downloads contain matching geometry and standard dielectric PBR fallback materials; custom browser optical shaders are not portable glTF materials
limitations: Illustrative design only. Does not reproduce proprietary retention geometry or establish gemological, optical, manufacturing or retention performance. Real-time rendering remains distinct from offline reference photography. Reconstructed band and case retain some inferred shape irregularities.

details: Shallow crowned deck, rounded shoulder and perimeter seam
Thirty recessed polished seat channels below the diamond girdles
Raised rounded inner ring above the dial edge
Gentle transverse crown on reconstructed bracelet links, polished center and satin-polished outer surfaces
contourRefinement.preserved: Diamond shader, gemstone size and position, studio reflections and sapphire shader unchanged

finishRefinement.bezel: Directional procedural satin grain; roughness .34; polished borders and seats retained
finishRefinement.bracelet: Longitudinal grain with .29 centre-link, .36 outer-link and .42 clasp roughness
finishRefinement.dialDetails: Applied chamfered baton markers, inset faces, tapered bevelled sword hands, fine seconds hand and tiered pivot
finishRefinement.diamonds: Watch-only subtle white sheen, existing facet refraction retained
finishRefinement.exportNote: GLB includes updated geometry and satin roughness; procedural brushing and optical sheen are browser shader effects.

contrastRefinement.hands: Brighter silver surfaces, widened tapered profiles, raised twin facets and central ridge; mixed diffuse/specular PBR approximation for dial legibility
contrastRefinement.accents: Rose-gold inner bezel and all thirty diamond-seat edges, kept below the exposed diamond crowns
contrastRefinement.depth: Geometry-derived concavity shading on reconstructed metal; camera-dependent contact occlusion; dark recessed perimeter seam
contrastRefinement.caseback: Satin back plate with concentric details and six slotted recessed screw heads; illustrative geometry
contrastRefinement.exportNote: Updated geometry and standard PBR finishes are exported. Custom recess shading and screen-space contact occlusion are browser effects, alongside the existing optical and brushing shaders.
